name: fieldtrip-linkedin-tracker
description: Fieldtrip webinar-lead LinkedIn tracker. Prepares HeyReach-ready lead CSVs from webinar registrant exports (with ColdIQ enrichment) and reconciles each user's LinkedIn inbox, read-only, against one shared Notion database.

plugins.name: fieldtrip-linkedin-tracker
plugins.description: /fieldtrip-linkedin-tracker: import webinar registrants into HeyReach-ready CSVs and a shared Notion database, then track who connected and replied from your LinkedIn inbox. Read-only on LinkedIn: a bundled hook blocks every send tool.
